# Changelog

All notable changes are documented here.

## [2.1.0] - 2026-03-02

### Added
- Cascade index for repositories above 5,000 files.

### Fixed
- Receipt mismatch after rebase.

## [2.0.1] - 2026-02-10

### Fixed
- Windows path separators in the repository map.

## [2.0.0] - 2026-01-15

### Changed
- Retrieval now fuses six query views.
- The `--budget` flag accepts values from 256 to 32000.

### Removed
- Legacy single-view ranker.
